name: FREN 5365
title: Topics in Nineteenth-Century French Media
description: Explores visual, spectacle-oriented, and print media; the commercial and technological dimensions of nineteenth-century media production, genre, advertising, and information theory; and the ways in which these elements challenge traditional literary categories. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in LCL, others with instructor consent.
